STEP 2. Check the column switch power supply circuit 
(battery circuit) at the column switch connector C-86 by 
back probing.
(1) Disconnect the column switch connector C-86 and measure 
at the harness side.
(2) Voltage between terminal 1 and ground.
Q: Is the voltage approximately 12 volts (battery positive 
voltage)?
YES : Go to Step 8.
NO : Go to Step 3.
STEP 3. Check the column switch connector C-86 for 
damage.
Q: Is column switch connector C-86 in good condition?
YES : Go to Step 4.
NO : Repair or replace it. Refer to GROUP 00E, Harness 
Connector Inspection P.00E-2. Confirm the DTC 12 is 
not displayed.
